title: Store SEO Settings
description: Configure SEO settings to improve your store's visibility in search engines and drive organic traffic.
content:
Store SEO Settings

Search Engine Optimization (SEO) helps your store appear in search results and attract organic traffic. Configure these settings to improve your store's visibility.

General SEO Settings

Access SEO settings from Store Settings → SEO:

  • Meta Title: Default title for search engines (recommended: 50-60 characters)
  • Meta Description: Brief description shown in search results (recommended: 150-160 characters)
  • Meta Keywords: Relevant keywords for your store (comma-separated)
  • Focus Keyword: Primary keyword you want to rank for

Open Graph Settings

Configure how your store appears when shared on social media:

  • Open Graph image (1200x630px recommended)
  • Open Graph title
  • Open Graph description

Structured Data

Enable structured data (Schema.org) for better search engine understanding:

  • Organization schema
  • Product schema
  • Breadcrumb schema
  • Review schema

URL Structure

Configure URL settings:

  • URL slug format
  • Product URL structure
  • Category URL structure
  • Blog post URL structure
  • Custom page URLs

Robots.txt and Sitemap

Configure search engine crawling:

  • Robots.txt file settings
  • XML sitemap generation
  • Sitemap submission to search engines
  • Exclude pages from indexing

Page-Specific SEO

Each page, product, and category has its own SEO settings:

  • Custom meta title
  • Custom meta description
  • Custom meta keywords
  • Canonical URL
  • No-index option

SEO Best Practices

  • Use relevant, descriptive keywords naturally
  • Write unique meta descriptions for each page
  • Optimize images with alt text
  • Create unique, keyword-rich content
  • Build internal links between related pages
  • Ensure fast page load times
  • Make your store mobile-friendly
  • Use HTTPS (automatically enabled)

Monitoring SEO Performance

Track your SEO performance:

  • Monitor search rankings
  • Track organic traffic in Analytics
  • Use Google Search Console
  • Review page speed metrics
